item.description:
# Weft 1.0.3
- Discover more existing Git projects, including Node, Python, Go, Rust, Swift, and Docker projects, with local launch configuration for ambiguous projects. - Run multiple projects at the same time with independent service controls. - Prepare supported tools and repository dependencies before starting, respecting repository versions and lockfiles. - Show installation progress, results, last-installed dates, and dependency updates after changes to the current checkout. - Pause affected services during dependency installation and restore them after success while other projects keep running. - Keep generated project configuration outside repositories without creating weft.json or changing .gitignore. - Improve onboarding layout at wide window sizes and add Open arrows beside running web services. - Remove the system Python dependency from process launching.
